name.hr: 3D idejno rješenje manjeg sklopa / pojedinačnih elemenata
name.en: 3D concept design for a small furniture set / individual elements

description.hr: Primjeri uključuju TV zid, zidnu oblogu, manji sklop namještaja i slične zahvate.
description.en: Examples include a TV wall, wall cladding, a small furniture set, and similar projects.

basis.hr: po manjem sklopu ili skupini pojedinačnih elemenata
basis.en: per small set or group of individual elements

description.hr: Primjeri uključuju kupaonicu, dječju sobu, spavaću sobu, dnevni boravak i slične prostorije.
description.en: Examples include a bathroom, children's room, bedroom, living room, and similar spaces.

description.hr: Dva ili tri samostalna elementa ne smatraju se kompletnom kuhinjom.
description.en: Two or three standalone elements are not considered a complete kitchen.

calculationNotes.hr: Konačna cijena ovisi o broju i složenosti elemenata, rasporedu i ukupnoj zahtjevnosti projekta.
calculationNotes.en: The final price depends on the number and complexity of elements, the layout, and the overall project requirements.

name.en: Photorealistic visualization of an approved 3D model

description.hr: Uključuje do 2 kadra iste prostorije i izrađuje se nakon odobrenja konačnog 3D modela.
description.en: Includes up to 2 views of the same room and is produced after the final 3D model has been approved.

basis.en: for up to 2 views of the same room

description.hr: Jedna manja korekcija uključena je u osnovnu cijenu 3D idejnog rješenja.
description.en: One minor revision is included in the base price of the 3D concept design.

description.hr: Konačan iznos ovisi o opsegu izmjene.
description.en: The final amount depends on the scope of the revision.

description.hr: Cijena se određuje prema opsegu potrebnog rada.
description.en: The price is determined according to the scope of work required.

basis.en: according to the required scope of work

description.hr: Popust se primjenjuje na ukupnu cijenu 3D projektiranja. Fotorealistične vizualizacije nisu dio osnovice za popust.
description.en: The discount applies to the total 3D design price. Photorealistic visualizations are excluded from the discount basis.

basis.en: on the total eligible 3D design price

label.hr: Paketni popust za projekt 4 ili više prostorija
label.en: Package discount for a project covering 4 or more rooms
